description: Staff shift schedule document for a medical center showing weekly employee shift assignments

title.description: The title of the schedule document, typically found at the top of the page
title.field_description: Extract the main heading/title of the document

facility.description: The name of the medical facility
facility.field_description: Extract the facility or medical center name shown below the title

weekStartDate.description: The start date of the schedule week in YYYY-MM-DD format
weekStartDate.field_description: Extract the week start date from the subtitle text (e.g., 'Week of October 10, 2025') and format as YYYY-MM-DD

employees.description: List of employees and their weekly shift assignments

employeeName.field_description: Extract the employee name from the 'Employee' column

employeeId.field_description: Extract the employee ID from the 'ID' column

department.field_description: Extract the department name from the 'Department' column

shifts.description: Array of 7 shift entries for each day of the week (Fri through Thu)

type.description: Type of shift: Morning, Afternoon, Night, Leave, or empty
type.field_description: Extract the shift type from the cell. If the cell contains a time-based shift (Morning, Afternoon, Night), extract that keyword. If it contains 'Leave' (Leave Personal, Leave Training, Leave Sick Leave, Leave Vacation), set as 'Leave'. If the cell is blank, set as 'empty'.

hours.description: The time range for the shift, null if Leave or empty
hours.field_description: Extract the time range shown below the shift type (e.g., '07:00-15:00' for Morning, '15:00-23:00' for Afternoon, '23:00-07:00' for Night). Set to null if the shift type is Leave or empty.
